name: combat-target-boss-hud
description: Actual wall HP/hit estimate and Titan phase/HP/countdown with current display names, menu and stale-target cleanup, rendered control clearance, responsive devices and bounded presentation writes.

steps.label: create owned desktop HUD fixture device
start isolated combat HUD play
wait for isolated profile and HUD

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local players=game.Players:GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'requires one isolated player') local p=players[1] local world=workspace.PunchWallRPG local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio() and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false and game.ServerStorage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'requires ephemeral Studio with no live data opt-in')
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'profile must be ready ephemeral and nonwritable')
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok and c:Invoke('ResetWorld').ok,'reset failed') assert(c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=2,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,FistMastery=0,Rebirths=0,HonorPowerBonus=0}).ok,'partial damage seed failed')
task.wait(.5) local root=assert(p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')) p:SetAttribute('SmashCombatHUDRootWasAnchored',root.Anchored) root.Anchored=true
local block=world['Depth Blocks'].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 p:SetAttribute('SmashCombatHUDFixtureTarget',block.Name) root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(block.Position+Vector3.new(0,0,8),block.Position)
local result=c:Invoke('HitWall','Brick Wall') assert(result.ok and block:GetAttribute('HP')==6 and block:GetAttribute('MaxHP')==8 and not block:GetAttribute('Broken'),'authoritative partial damage incorrect')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,hp=block:GetAttribute('HP'),maxHP=block:GetAttribute('MaxHP'),target=block.Name})

steps.label: seed a stationary actual partial-damage target

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local function awaitCondition(fn,message,seconds) local deadline=os.clock()+(seconds or 5) repeat if fn() then return end task.wait(.03) until os.clock()>=deadline error(message) end
local function visible(o) local n=o while n do if n:IsA('GuiObject') and not n.Visible then return false end n=n.Parent end return true end
local function overlaps(a,b) return a.AbsolutePosition.X < b.AbsolutePosition.X+b.AbsoluteSize.X and a.AbsolutePosition.X+a.AbsoluteSize.X > b.AbsolutePosition.X and a.AbsolutePosition.Y < b.AbsolutePosition.Y+b.AbsoluteSize.Y and a.AbsolutePosition.Y+a.AbsoluteSize.Y > b.AbsolutePosition.Y end
local function verifyPanel(panel,title,detail)
 local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local p,s=panel.AbsolutePosition,panel.AbsoluteSize local o,v=safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize
 assert(visible(panel) and s.X>0 and s.Y>0,'combat panel not actually visible')
 assert(p.X>=o.X-1 and p.Y>=o.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=o.X+v.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=o.Y+v.Y+1,'combat panel outside actual safe viewport')
 local count=0 for _,button in ipairs(safe:GetDescendants()) do if button:IsA('GuiButton') and visible(button) and button.Active then assert(not overlaps(panel,button),'combat panel covers active control '..button.Name) count+=1 end end assert(count>0,'no actual controls audited')
 for _,label in ipairs({title,detail}) do assert(label.Text~='' and label.TextBounds.X>0 and label.TextBounds.Y>0,'combat text not rendered') assert(label.TextBounds.X<=label.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and label.TextBounds.Y<=label.AbsoluteSize.Y+1,'combat text clipped '..label.Name) end
 assert(title.CombatReadability.MinTextSize>=14 and detail.CombatReadability.MinTextSize>=12,'readability floors missing')
 return count
end
a:Invoke('CloseMenus') local target=p:GetAttribute('SmashCombatHUDFixtureTarget') local block=workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']:FindFirstChild(target) assert(block,'fixture target missing')
awaitCondition(function()return g.TargetWallHUD.Visible and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==target end,'actual wall HUD did not acquire fixture block')
assert(not g.BossHUD.Visible,'wall/boss ownership overlaps')
assert(g.TargetWallHUD.TargetTitle.Text==string.upper(block:GetAttribute('TierName')),'themed wall title incorrect')
assert(g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDCanonicalTarget')=='Brick Wall','canonical identity lost')
assert(math.abs(g.TargetWallHUD.HealthTrack.HealthFill.Size.X.Scale-block:GetAttribute('HP')/block:GetAttribute('MaxHP'))<.001,'actual wall HP fill mismatch')
assert(g.TargetWallHUD.TargetDetail.Text:find('HP 6/8',1,true) and g.TargetWallHUD.TargetDetail.Text:find('~3 hits',1,true),'actual wall HP/hit estimate incorrect')
local outline=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('Local Target Highlight')) assert(outline.Enabled and outline.Adornee==block,'actual outline target wrong')
local count=verifyPanel(g.TargetWallHUD,g.TargetWallHUD.TargetTitle,g.TargetWallHUD.TargetDetail) local before=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDRenderCount') task.wait(.65) assert(g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDRenderCount')==before,'unchanged target rewrites presentation')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,target=target,auditedControls=count,idleCoalesced=true})
